evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Per-tool unit-test pass rates reach 63.8\%, while project-level integration success does not exceed 45\%, suggesting that integration remains a major bottleneck even when isolated tool tests pass.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate 11 representative LLMs in a single-turn foundation-model setting, assessing generated artifacts through static analysis, unit and integration tests, and process-isolated end-to-end execution.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension.
